description: The Earth Pig in Chinese astrology: personality, Earth element traits, 1959 and 2019 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Earth Pig is the Pig born in a Earth year, one of five versions of the twelfth animal. It combines the Pig's generosity with Earth's qualities. Earth Pig years between 1924 and 2044 are 1959 and 2019. The Pig's fixed element is Water.

sections.heading: The Earth Pig personality
paragraphs: Earth controls Water, and the Pig always carries Water, so in an Earth year the stem is said to contain and steady the Pig's flowing generosity. Earth Pigs are often described as the most practical and dependable of their sign: hardworking, patient and devoted to family and home. They tend to be good with resources and enjoy building comfortable, secure lives. Their kindness is quiet but constant. The containing influence brings stability, though readings mention a tendency towards caution, stubbornness and a reluctance to step outside the comfortable world they have built, along with occasional indulgence in comfort as a way to soothe worry. Visitors usually leave their homes well fed and in better spirits than they arrived.

In classical thought, Earth belongs to the centre and to the late-summer pause between seasons, the point where things ripen and settle. As a year stem, it tends to slow an animal down in a useful way, adding prudence, loyalty and a strong sense of responsibility. People born under an Earth stem are often described as dependable, sensible and protective of the people they love. They value security and tend to build carefully. The caution traditionally attached to Earth is caution itself: overthinking, clinging to the familiar and carrying other people's problems as though they were their own.

sections.heading: Earth Pig at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, Earth is usually associated with management, organisation and long-term stewardship. Earth-year people are often described as the steady hands who keep systems running, look after budgets and notice when colleagues are struggling, which suits administration, property, finance, agriculture, healthcare and operations. They tend to earn trust slowly and keep it. The traditional caution is resistance to change: an Earth stem may hold on to a process after it has stopped working, so regular reviews and a willingness to experiment help.

Contentment through steady effort is the Earth Pig's hallmark. Catering, property management, retail ownership, agriculture and bookkeeping are commonly mentioned, since patience and a practical eye for comfort build value over time. It is a cheerful, reliable colleague who rarely seeks the limelight yet notices when the team needs feeding or a breather. In close relationships, the Earth Pig creates a warm, well-provisioned home and offers calm, unshowy devotion. It values security and a companion content with simple pleasures. The sore spot tends to be complacency: so comfortable with routine that necessary changes, from health habits to household plans, get postponed until a partner has to raise them repeatedly.

sections.heading: Earth Pig years and dates
paragraphs: Earth Pig years in the Lunar New Year table run from February 8, 1959 to January 27, 1960 and from February 5, 2019 to January 24, 2020. Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 1959 anyone born before Feb 8 is a Earth Dog, not a Earth Pig. Sixty years separate each Earth Pig year, the length of a full round of five elements and twelve animals. Every Earth Pig year is Yin, matching the Pig's own polarity.

Its traditional name is Ji-Hai: Ji is the yin Earth stem and Hai is the Pig's branch. Births just before each new year fall in the Earth Dog year (before February 8, 1959) and the Earth Dog year (before February 5, 2019), and births in the weeks after each Earth Pig year ends belong to the Metal Rat. The new year itself fell on a Sunday in 1959 and Tuesday in 2019.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Earth Pig
paragraphs: Earth Pigs often benefit from gentle stretching beyond familiar routines. Small adventures, such as travel, new hobbies or fresh friendships, keep containment from turning into confinement. Because they look after others steadily, they need to receive care too, and asking for it directly helps. Mindful habits around food and comfort prevent indulgence from becoming a habit of escape. Earth Pigs often excel in careers involving stewardship, hospitality or practical support. When security is balanced with curiosity, Earth Pigs become generous, dependable hubs for family and friends. A little spontaneity keeps their contentment fresh.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Earth Pig shares the Pig's San He trine with the Rabbit and Goat (the Wood trine), its Liu He bond with the Tiger, and its Liu Chong clash with the Snake. The element adds a second layer: another Earth sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Earth in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Earth Pig years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1959 (from February 8, 1959) and 2019 (from February 5, 2019). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Earth Pig's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Earth and the Pig's fixed element is Water; in the five-element cycles earth controls Water. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Earth Pig?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Rabbit and Goat (San He) and the Tiger (Liu He). The Snake is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Earth Pig called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Ji-Hai. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Earth stem Ji, followed by its earthly branch, here Hai for the Pig, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Earth Pig different from other Pigs?
faq.answer: All Pigs share generosity, sincerity and warmth. The Earth year element changes the tone: earth sits at the centre of the five-element wheel, and an Earth year is traditionally said to give any animal steadiness, patience and a practical turn of mind.
